title: Towing and Labor Coverage Benefit Payment Basis
content:
**Payment rule.** Under **Towing and Labor Coverage** a disablement is paid at the lower of the provider's or receipt's charges and the package's per-disablement limit, rounded to the cent. A second service for the same disablement on the same day shares that limit, and charges above it are the customer's. Only one benefit payment is made per service reference. Network providers are paid on their dispatch invoice; out-of-network services are reimbursed to the named insured within 10 calendar days of complete receipts.

## Elements of the rule

- **Amount.** The payment is the lower of two figures: the charges on the provider's invoice or on the receipt, and the per-disablement limit of the package on the vehicle (the figure in the package name, from $50 for the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $50 package to $200 for the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $200 package). The amount is rounded to the cent.
- **Shared limit.** A second service for the same disablement on the same day draws on the same limit as the first; the two services together are paid no more than one limit.
- **Excess.** Charges above the limit are the customer's.
- **One payment per service reference.** The company's benefit records are checked, before payment, for a benefit already paid under the same service reference; where one exists, no further benefit payment is made under that reference.
- **Payee and timing.**

| Service | Paid to | When |
|---|---|---|
| Dispatched by the company to a network provider | The provider | On its dispatch invoice |
| Arranged by the customer outside the network | The named insured | Within 10 calendar days of complete receipts |

The benefits recorded on a coverage are the benefits paid less any reversals.

## Worked payments (hypothetical inputs)

| Package | Charges | Lower of charges and limit | Paid | Customer's share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $100 | $82.40 invoice | $82.40 | $82.40 | $0.00 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $50 | $73.10 receipt | $50.00 | $50.00 | $23.10 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $200 | $200.00 invoice | $200.00 | $200.00 | $0.00 |

*Shared limit, hypothetical:* on the Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $75 package, a jump-start costing $40.00 and, later the same day, a tow costing $60.00 for the same disablement share one $75.00 limit. The two payments together do not exceed $75.00; of the $100.00 charged, $25.00 is the customer's.
